Chicken-Stuffing Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 19, 2010 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




1 pkg. dried dressing mix (Stove Top)
1 can cream of chicken soup
1/2 can water
2 sm. cans boned chicken (left over turkey or 1 stick butter
1 cup boiling water

Preparation

1 Heat 1 cup water and 1 stick butter and mix with dressing. Pack 1/2 dressing mix into 8x8x2 pan. Mix together soup and 1/2 can water and put on top of dressing, then chicken. Put rest of dressing mix on top of chicken. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.
